answer.reason: The verses name Abishalom only as the father of Maachah, which is exactly what the summary already says, and record nothing he did or that happened to him.
doubts: 2CH 13:2 names Michaiah daughter of Uriel, a different mother of Abijah; it does not concern Abishalom, so it was left out.
2CH 11:20-21 spell the name Absalom and may refer to the same man, but they say nothing more of him.
